glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): a differentiated form of 大 (“big; great”) with a 丶 added to represent 太 (“too big”). Compare 泰, which is also a differentiated form with 廾 and 水 added instead.
senses: [tài] too; so (modifying adjectives; often used with 了 at the end of the sentence for emphasis)
[tā] (obsolete in standard Chinese) only used in 太末
